Specification: This specification is a small TLC test module designed to check that the model checker reports an error when an operator is invoked with too few arguments. It defines a single Boolean state variable x, initializes it to TRUE, and then allows only stuttering steps via UNCHANGED x. The module includes a binary operator Foo(a, b) but intentionally calls it as Foo(x) in the invariant Inv, so the main purpose of the spec is tooling validation rather than modeling a distributed algorithm or fault-tolerant protocol.
FunctionApplication: Print("Should complain that operator Foo is called with too few arguments", TRUE)
StringLiterals: Should complain that operator Foo is called with too few arguments
